name: TypeScript Basics
description: Primitive types, type inference, type annotations, and the fundamentals of the TypeScript type system.

name: Interfaces & Type Aliases
description: Defining shapes with interfaces and type aliases, structural typing, and declaration merging.

name: Functions
description: Function types, optional and default parameters, rest parameters, and function overloads.

name: Generics
description: Generic functions, interfaces, constraints, and built-in utility types.

name: Classes & OOP
description: TypeScript classes, access modifiers, inheritance, abstract classes, and constructor patterns.

name: Advanced Types
description: Union, intersection, conditional, mapped, and template literal types.

name: Async Programming & Promises
description: Promise typing, async/await, error propagation, concurrent promise combinators, and asynchronous control flow.

name: Modules & Module Resolution
description: ES modules, imports and exports, type-only imports, dynamic imports, module resolution, and declaration augmentation.

name: Compiler Configuration & Build Tooling
description: Important tsconfig options, compiler targets, declaration generation, project references, and TypeScript build behavior.

name: Runtime Validation & Error Handling
description: Runtime validation at trust boundaries, safe error handling, assertion functions, and the distinction between static types and runtime values.

name: TypeScript in Real-World Applications
description: Practical patterns for API responses, configuration, reusable data models, callbacks, and maintainable application code.
